modified.text: The system SHALL keep exactly five tiers in fixed order: trivial, routine, medium, high and escalate, each with an id, a name, a definition, an ordered model list and an optional reasoning effort. Escalate SHALL never be offered to Laya or the kNN overlay as a routing answer, and the lead's team_dispatch SHALL refuse it for fresh work; team_resume and team_route_fix MAY move an existing worker to it.

scenarios.name: Routing never picks escalate
when: routing mode is auto and Laya classifies a dispatch
then: the chosen tier is one of trivial, routine, medium or high

scenarios.name: Lead picks escalate for fresh work
when: the lead calls team_dispatch with tier escalate
then: the dispatch is refused as escalation only, never a first pick
no worker is provisioned

scenarios.name: Escalating an existing worker
when: the lead calls team_resume on an idle worker with tier escalate
then: the worker restarts on the escalate tier, folding down when it has no model

added.requirement: Tool calls attach the external lead
added.text: The system SHALL attach the external lead to a project's team on the first MCP tools/call for that project, and SHALL NOT attach it for initialize, tools/list, ping or a notices read.

scenarios.name: Opening Claude Code
when: Claude Code starts in a registered project and lists the Mnemo tools
then: the in-app lead keeps receiving worker notices

scenarios.name: First tool call
when: a helper forwards a tools/call for the project
then: the external lead is attached and worker notices queue for it

added.requirement: A closing helper keeps the lead while another helper led
added.text: The system SHALL remember every helper id that made a tools/call while the external lead is attached, and a helper's detach on close SHALL release the lead only when no other remembered helper remains. A detach that names no helper SHALL release the lead.

scenarios.name: Second helper closes
when: helpers a and b both made tool calls
helper b closes
then: the external lead stays attached and its waiter keeps waiting

scenarios.name: Last helper closes
when: helper a is the only remembered helper
helper a closes
then: the external lead is released
unread notices go to the in-app lead

scenarios.name: Anonymous detach
when: a detach arrives without a helper id
then: the external lead is released

added.requirement: Idle external leads are released
added.text: The system SHALL release an external lead that made no Mnemo call for 10 minutes while no waiter runs, regardless of remembered helpers, and SHALL forget every remembered helper on any release.

scenarios.name: Crashed helper
when: the only leading helper crashed without detaching
10 minutes pass with no call and no waiter
then: the external lead is released

added.requirement: Workers get the whole plan at dispatch
added.text: The system SHALL give every implementation worker, at dispatch, its plan's title, goal, kind, context, decisions, interfaces, acceptance scenarios, spec changes, schema sections, the step list and the full text of its own step, followed by the lead's brief, and SHALL NOT include the plan's progress notes.

scenarios.name: Dispatch header
when: the lead dispatches a worker on step 2 of a plan with a decision and a spec change
then: the worker's instructions contain the decision, the spec change and step 2's full text before the brief

added.requirement: Workers can re-read their plan
added.text: The system SHALL offer workers a read-only plan_read tool that returns their own plan as it stands now, or with a capability name that capability's current OpenSpec spec, and every dispatch header SHALL say so. plan_read SHALL never return another plan.

scenarios.name: Decision after dispatch
when: the lead records a decision after a worker started
the worker calls plan_read
then: the result contains the new decision

scenarios.name: Current spec
when: a worker calls plan_read with capability tier-ladder
then: the result is the current tier-ladder spec

added.requirement: Working workers hear about plan changes
added.text: The system SHALL send each worker that is working on a plan a short notice naming what changed when the plan's context, decisions, interfaces, steps, acceptance scenarios, spec changes or sections change, and SHALL NOT notify idle, completed, in-review or merged workers or notify on progress notes.

scenarios.name: Decision recorded
when: a worker is working on a plan
the lead records a decision on it
then: the worker receives 'Plan <id> changed: new decision. Call plan_read to re-read it before you continue.'

scenarios.name: Worker awaiting review
when: a worker finished its turn and awaits review
the lead records a decision
then: the worker receives nothing

added.requirement: Leaving with unsaved edits asks first
added.text: The settings dialog SHALL ask for confirmation before closing or switching pages while any page holds unsaved edits, and SHALL close or switch without asking when none does.

scenarios.name: Close with unsaved edits
when: a settings page has an unsaved edit
the user presses the close button, Escape or the backdrop
then: the dialog stays open and asks to discard unsaved changes

scenarios.name: Switch page with unsaved edits
when: a settings page has an unsaved edit
the user picks another page in the rail
then: the page does not change until the user chooses Discard changes

scenarios.name: No unsaved edits
when: no settings page has an unsaved edit
the user closes the dialog
then: the dialog closes at once

added.requirement: Non-gating classification never blocks dispatch
added.text: When a dispatch carries an explicit lead or user tier or model choice, the system SHALL start the worker without waiting for the routing classification, SHALL run the classification in the background under the same permit and timeout, and SHALL attach its label to the worker's routing record when it completes, logging it as calibration and training data.

scenarios.name: Explicit-tier dispatch starts without the classification
when: a lead dispatches with an explicit tier
the routing classifier is still pending
then: the worker starts immediately
the routing block shows routed_by lead with a null Laya label

scenarios.name: The background label lands on the record
when: the background classification completes
then: the worker's routing record carries the Laya tier, confidence and cleared flag
the training data records the override label

scenarios.name: Non-explicit dispatches still gate on the classification
when: a dispatch carries no explicit tier or model choice
then: an unsure classifier refuses a Suggest+auto dispatch
a cleared decision runs Laya's tier in Auto mode
offline or too-short text produces the same skip reasons as before

added.requirement: Model prices have one editor
added.text: Mnemo2's settings dialog SHALL edit model prices only with each model on the Endpoints page, and the Savings page SHALL NOT offer a pricing table.

scenarios.name: Savings page points to Endpoints
when: the user opens the Savings page
then: no pricing table is shown
a line says prices are set with each model on the Endpoints page

added.requirement: Every model call is traced with attribution
added.text: The Trace tab SHALL record every model request and response the engine makes — the lead's and every worker's alike — with full attribution (actor kind, agent name, worker id, plan and step), phase timings, token usage and cost, and SHALL keep them queryable by agent, model, status, purpose and time, and exportable.

scenarios.name: A worker's call appears with its attribution
when: a worker makes an LLM call
then: the trace list shows the call with the worker's name, plan and step

scenarios.name: Calls are filterable
when: the user filters by agent, model, status, purpose or time
then: only matching calls remain in the list and the charts

added.requirement: Non-overlapping phase segments
added.text: The phase bar SHALL draw non-overlapping segments — Setup (containing Compaction), Upload, Server wait, Generation (containing Reasoning and Stall), Retry wait and Tools — and SHALL render Connect and First token as metric chips rather than bar segments. For SSE providers, response headers arrive with the first chunk, so Server wait carries the server's queue and prefill.

scenarios.name: The bar decomposes a call
when: a call has prep, upload, server and generation windows
then: the bar shows those segments in order with no overlap and no double-counted window

scenarios.name: Legacy rows collapse absent segments
when: a row predates the upload and server stamps
then: those segments collapse and the bar renders without NaN

added.requirement: Finer live statuses
added.text: An in-flight call SHALL derive its live status from its stamped fields — preparing, uploading, waiting for first token, streaming, or stalled — and terminal calls SHALL classify as complete, failed, cancelled or guard-cut.

scenarios.name: The ladder walks a live call
when: a polled row gains its stamps
then: the status walks uploading, then waiting for first token, then streaming

scenarios.name: A stalled stream is visible
when: a streaming call goes silent past the stall threshold
then: its status shows stalled

added.requirement: Agent scoping with Lead default
added.text: The Trace tab SHALL offer an agent dropdown listing Lead first, every observed worker, and All, SHALL default it to Lead, and SHALL scope both the call list and the top Insights charts to the selected agent's calls.

scenarios.name: The tab opens on the Lead
when: the trace opens with no saved preference
then: the dropdown shows Lead selected and the charts show only the Lead's calls

scenarios.name: A worker is selectable
when: the user picks a worker from the dropdown
then: the list and charts show only that worker's calls

added.requirement: Spec-impact gate on plan creation
added.text: plan_create SHALL refuse a plan whose steps touch files governed by a capability's file map unless the plan carries a spec delta for that capability or an explicit no-spec-impact declaration with a reason; the refusal SHALL name the capability and both remedies. A spec delta that creates a new capability SHALL declare its governed files. plan_update add_steps SHALL apply the same gate to steps added after creation.

scenarios.name: A governed-file plan without a delta is refused
when: a plan's steps touch a capability's governed files
no spec delta for that capability is attached
no explicit no-impact declaration is carried
then: plan_create refuses
the refusal names the capability and both remedies

scenarios.name: A delta or an explicit declaration passes
when: the same plan carries a spec delta for the capability
or an explicit no-spec-impact declaration with a reason
then: plan_create accepts the plan

scenarios.name: New capabilities declare their governed files
when: a spec delta adds a new capability without a governed-files entry
then: the plan is refused until the files are declared

scenarios.name: Steps added later are gated too
when: plan_update add_steps names a governed file without a delta or declaration
then: the same refusal fires

added.requirement: Laya needs one decision from the user
added.text: The Tiers page SHALL ask only how much Laya helps pick the tier, and SHALL NOT offer inputs for confidence gates, minimum words, fallback tier, kNN, nudges or per-tier dispatch effort.

scenarios.name: Leaving without edits
when: the user opens the Tiers page and changes nothing
the user picks another page
then: the page changes without asking about unsaved edits

added.requirement: The Laya check runs itself and shows progress
added.text: Mnemo2 SHALL check Laya when a project opens if the test set or checkpoint changed, SHALL show its progress like indexing, SHALL apply the suggested gates itself, and MUST write nothing when Laya does not answer.

scenarios.name: Stale check at project open
when: a project opens with a Laya choice other than off and no matching check
then: the status line shows Checking Laya with done and total
the gates and the result are saved when it ends

scenarios.name: Nothing changed
when: a project opens and the last check's fingerprint matches
then: no check runs and the page shows the last result

scenarios.name: Laya does not answer
when: the classifier stops answering during a check
then: the check shows as failed
no record is written and the gates stay as stored

Test-only change in src-tauri/src/mnemo2/team/tests.rs; no specified behaviour changes.

added.requirement: Routing decisions travel with the repository and the installer
added.text: A project that keeps a `.coding/laya/` folder SHALL carry its own routing decisions in `.coding/laya/dispatch_routing.jsonl`, as verbatim rows of the routing log whose plan belongs to that project, and the Mnemo2 installer SHALL ship that file. When a project opens, the system SHALL import a shipped copy by appending only, SHALL import silently when this computer has no decisions the copy lacks, and SHALL ask the user before importing when it has.

scenarios.name: A fresh computer imports silently
when: a project opens on a computer whose routing log lacks the shipped rows and has none of its own
then: the rows are appended to the routing log without a question

scenarios.name: A conflicting copy asks
when: a project opens and this computer has decisions the shipped copy lacks, and the copy has decisions this computer lacks
then: the user is asked whether to update
and: updating appends the missing rows and removes nothing
declining leaves the log unchanged and the same copy does not ask again

scenarios.name: Only opted-in projects export
when: a worker merges in a project without a .coding/laya folder
then: no decision rows are written into that project

added.requirement: Drift nudges read only new guidance
added.text: The system SHALL run the drift check only on a lead or user message that can carry new work. It SHALL NOT classify text Mnemo2 generated itself (a route-fix brief or a plan-changed notice) or the first lead or user message a read-back worker receives, so those messages never produce a drift nudge and never spend the worker's one nudge. Any other lead or user message of at least `min_words` words SHALL still be classified in the background, and SHALL nudge the lead when the answer clears on a tier above the worker's.

scenarios.name: Read-back answer
when: a worker dispatched with read_back receives its first lead message of at least min_words words
then: Laya is not asked about that message
no drift nudge is sent
and: the worker's one nudge stays available

scenarios.name: Plan notices before the read-back answer
when: a read-back worker has received only Mnemo2 plan-changed notices
the lead then sends its answer
then: Laya is not asked about the answer

scenarios.name: Route-fix prompt
when: team_route_fix delivers a fix brief to a worker
then: Laya is not asked about the brief as drift
no drift nudge is sent

scenarios.name: A later message adds scope
when: a worker receives a lead message of at least min_words words that is not its read-back answer
Laya clears the message on a tier above the worker's
then: the lead gets a "this got harder" notice
a nudge row with reason drift is logged
